title: Monitors and docking stations during the move
text: IT packs and moves every monitor, docking station and keyboard from Station Road. They are set up on the shared desks at Riverside House before Monday 7 December. If a monitor you used is not there, you do not need to find it: every desk has two monitors. Report a missing or broken device to it-help@example.com.

title: Wi-Fi at Riverside House
text: The staff network is 'Riverside-Staff'. Laptops get the settings in the IT update on Tuesday 1 December, so keep your laptop switched on and connected that day. Guests use 'Riverside-Guest' with a code from reception.

title: Printing with your badge
text: Send your print to 'Riverside-Print'. At any printer, hold your access badge to the reader to release it. Prints you do not release are deleted after 24 hours.

title: The laptop update on 1 December
text: On Tuesday 1 December IT sends an update to every laptop. It installs the Riverside House Wi-Fi and printer settings and restarts the laptop once. It takes about 20 minutes.

title: Reporting a broken or missing device
text: Email it-help@example.com with what is broken or missing and your desk number. IT answers within 1 working day.

title: Parking at Riverside House
text: There are 20 parking spaces, booked in the DeskBook app from Monday 30 November. 4 accessible spaces next to the entrance are kept for staff with a blue badge or a medical need; ask facilities@example.com to reserve one permanently.

title: Bikes and showers
text: Covered storage for 40 bikes is behind the building, reached from Canal Street. Showers and changing rooms are on the ground floor. Use your access badge to open the bike store.

title: Access badges
text: New badges are handed out at reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December. Bring photo ID. The badge opens the doors, the lockers, the bike store and the printers.

title: Personal evacuation plans
text: If you may need help to leave the building in an emergency, facilities makes a personal evacuation plan with you. Ask before Monday 7 December at facilities@example.com. Evacuation chairs are kept at every stairwell, and trained fire wardens help people with a plan.

title: Lockers and kitchens
text: Lockers are on floor 2 and open with your badge; empty yours on Fridays. Every floor has a kitchen, and the ground-floor canteen is open from 11:30 to 14:00.

title: Hybrid working after the move
text: The hybrid-work rule does not change with the move. Full-time staff can work from home up to 2 days a week, agreed with their manager.

title: First day for new starters in December
text: New starters whose first day is Monday 7 December go to reception at 09:00, collect their badge with photo ID, and are met by their manager. Their laptop is ready at their team's zone. HR sends a welcome email the week before.

title: Part-time staff and home working
text: Part-time staff can work from home for up to 40% of their working days each week, rounded down. Someone working 3 days a week can work 1 of those days from home.

title: Travel costs after the move
text: Travel between home and the office is not paid for, at Station Road or at Riverside House. If the move makes your journey much longer, talk to your manager about your hours.

title: Worries about the move
text: If you are worried about the move, talk to your manager or to HR at hr@example.com. Conversations are private.
